title: NFL officially raises the 2026 salary cap to $301.2 million

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL officially raises the 2026 salary cap to $301.2 million
sources.description: The NFL has raised the salary cap in 2026 to $301.2 million. An increase of $22 million over last year. That will give the Denver Broncos a bump for free agency.
